title: The Deposition
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael prepares for and participates in a deposition related to Jan's wrongful termination lawsuit, revealing details about their complicated personal relationship and the circumstances of her firing. Meanwhile, office dynamics play out through ping-pong games and interpersonal interactions, including Michael's humorous and nervous behavior during questioning. The episode highlights tensions around the legal case, Michael's loyalty and nervousness, and the playful yet competitive atmosphere among coworkers.
